WHERE SUM(quantity) > 500 
GROUP BY product_id;

Under standard SQL semantics where the WHERE clause is evaluated before GROUP BY and before any aggregate computation occurs, and where every non-aggregate column in SELECT must appear in GROUP BY, this query is invalid and will not execute.

What prevents this query from executing successfully?

A. SUM function requires an alias in the SELECT clause
B. GROUP BY clause missing a column from the SELECT list
C. WHERE clause must appear after GROUP BY
D. Aggregate function used in the WHERE clause

Respond with only the letter of the correct option.
